 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 participant U as User (Browser)
 participant B as Web Backend (Your App)
 participant I as Identity Provider (IdP)
 participant R as Resource Server (API)

 U->>B: 1. User clicks \"Login with IdP\"
 B-->>U: 2. 302 → /authorize?response_type=code&client_id=...&state=xyz
 U->>I: 3. GET /authorize (browser follows redirect)
 I-->>U: 4. 302 → /callback?code=AC_xxx&state=xyz
 U->>B: 5. GET /callback?code=AC_xxx
 B->>I: 6. POST /token { code, client_secret }
 I-->>B: 7. { access_token, refresh_token, id_token }
 B->>R: 8. GET /userinfo<br/>Authorization: Bearer AT_xxx
 R-->>B: 9. { sub: \"alice@poridhi.io\", name: \"Alice\" }
 B-->>U: 10. 200 OK — logged in! 🎉

 Note over B, I: client_secret used here ✅<br/>Because this is a CONFIDENTIAL client —<br/>runs on a server.
 Note over I: Validates client_secret + code",
 "config": null
